messages:
Jordan (AE): FjordHealth just sent a formal ask — 3yr committed Dedicated + Private control plane. They want 42% off list + first 90 days of burst capacity free. Security requires SSO/SCIM, HSM-backed KMS, and an IP allowlist. SOC2 report will be provided next week. Need deal-desk approval to push a firm term sheet by EOW.
Ben (Deal Desk): Can you drop ACV and expected committed spend over 3 yrs? 42% is pretty deep, need comps and margin hit. Any reason we can't structure as stepped discounts?
Jordan (AE): Target ACV = $2.2M first year equivalent, $6.6M committed over 3yrs. Projection: Year1 heavier (POC->pilot->prod). They want ramp protection: guarantee capacity for first 90 days.
Rahul (SE): Technical ask: POC acceptance criteria — they want 10k concurrent qps for generation with <=120ms p95 at ~2k tokens typical. KV cache ok. For HSM we can integrate via customer KMS (bring-your-own) but need a config window. VPC peering + egress rules will be required for private deployment.
Lina (Finance): Quick calc — at 42% off list on $6.6M, revenue net is ~3.83M. Our COGS for Dedicated+ Private + burst credit looks like ~1.4M over term. Margin ~ 63% gross before rebates/infra credits. Need to confirm infra uplift for guaranteed burst.
Ben (Deal Desk): If Lina's calc holds, 42% might be acceptable if we make concessions conditional: (1) minimum commit $6M over 3yrs, (2) no additional discounts in year1, (3) 6-month ramp schedule with usage gates, (4) limited free burst (max $X) not open-ended. Recommend approval up to 30% off net list with burst credit cap — anything deeper needs CRO sign-off.
Carol (CSM): Also record that Fjord wants a trial success SLA: if POC hits acceptance criteria within 60 days, full commitment kicks in. They want dedicated onboarding assistance for first 30 days. We'll attach a services SOW, billable or discount credit?
Ava (Legal): We will need to review the DPA with HSM clause. IP allowlist and VPC peering are standard. For the 90-day free burst, we need a cap and explicit definition of "burst" (tokens or compute hours). Also clarify data residency clause for their EU customers.
Jordan (AE): Noted. I'll push back on 42% to 30% + capped burst credit and keep the rest conditional. If they push hard we may ask for CRO approval. Can Ben/Finance give an approval matrix I can present to customer?
Ben (Deal Desk): I can approve 30% off list if: commit >= $6M over 3yrs, quarterly usage reporting, and capped burst credit (recommend $75k total across 90 days). Anything else goes to CRO. I'll register this as a provisional offer in the deal desk queue.
Lina (Finance): Fine with 30% + $75k burst cap. Need channel-level incentives cleared (partner/referral?). Also require monthly invoicing cadence for first 12 months.
Rahul (SE): Operational note — to meet p95 <120ms at scale we should lock them to a high-priority pool; that adds ~8% infra uplift. Include that in margin calc.
Ben (Deal Desk): Good catch. Jordan, when you send the term sheet, include the infra uplift as a line item; we'll keep the 30% discount off list but exclude the uplift from discount calculations (net add-on).
pricing-bot: automated-check: recommended_floor_discount = 18%, suggested_approval_level = Deal Desk for up to 30%, CRO required above 30%.
Jordan (AE): Thanks all — I'll draft term sheet: 3yr commit, $6.6M gross list, 30% standard discount, $75k capped burst credit, infra uplift excluded from discount, SSO/SCIM + BYO-KMS with HSM, VPC peering included, POC acceptance criteria and 60-day trial success clause. Will loop Legal & CSM for attachments.
Ava (Legal): Once draft is in doc, send to me. I'll add DPA addendum for HSM and the burst credit cap language.
Carol (CSM): I'll prepare services SOW for onboarding. Jordan, cc me when you send so I can align resource availability.
Jordan (AE): Will do. Pushing to customer now, will update thread with their counter. :thumbsup:
